fileInput.dataUrl: derived: engine acceptFile → business_files.bytes, mime, size, sha256
customerInput.id: customers.id (the row changed; absent for a new customer)
itemInput.id: items.id (the row changed; absent for a new item)
issueBillInput.id: documents.id (the draft a refused attempt left; updated, never a second draft)
creditNoteBillInput.amount: derived: engine proportionalCredit → documents.lines of the credit note
inviteInput.phone: derived: engine toE164 → users.phone_e164 (the invited person)
inviteInput.name: users.name (a person new to EkBill; an existing one keeps theirs)
askInput.question: not stored: searched (search_records) and sent to the text model; ai_calls.input_hash keeps its hash
voiceNameInput.customerName: not stored: matched to customers.name (engine matchCustomer) to open a screen
voiceBillInput.customerName: not stored: matched to customers.name, or the new customer's name on the bill form (stored only when the owner issues)
voiceBillInput.lines: not stored: derived: engine linesFromSpeech → the bill form's lines (documents.lines only when the owner issues)
voiceAskInput.question: not stored: as askInput.question
